title: A code/<id> branch is named after the item whose code it carries
goal: kbgit.py sync names the code/<id> branch after the KB-Work id of the first code-lane commit in the range, not the first KB-Work id of any commit, so a content claim of another item riding along does not name the merge request (code/TK-5mrfocpz carried TK-opkxumeu's code in SP-v5xagbyv)

gates.question: When the range's first code-lane commit has no KB-Work but a later code-lane commit has one, which id names code/<id>?
options: the first KB-Work id among the range's code-lane commits, then the range's first id, then HEAD's short hash
only the first code-lane commit's id, then the range's first id, then HEAD's short hash
gates.recommendation: the first KB-Work id among the range's code-lane commits, then the range's first id, then HEAD's short hash
gates.answer: the first KB-Work id among the range's code-lane commits, then the range's first id, then HEAD's short hash
